title: Operations manager
notice_text:
This standard included a transition arrangement for the minimum off‑the‑job training requirement for learners starting between 1 August and 31 December 2025.
New starts on this apprenticeship are not government funded from 1st September 2026. Any apprentice who started this apprenticeship before 1st September 2026 will continue to be funded through to completion. This apprenticeship remains available for delivery for privately funded apprentices.
version_log: Occupational standard, end-point assessment plan and funding band revised
The funding band for this standard has been reviewed as part of the apprenticeship funding band review. The new funding band is £7000
